The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors. The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`:

```java
if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)) {
```

- Configured teams are untouched: the matching branch runs before this check, so their members stay in regardless of activity.
- Blank latest-commit dates count as active. `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank date, so `Contributor.isActive()` covers it without extra code.
- The remainder is still only added to the team list when it has members and repositories, as before.

`codeanalyzer` compiles offline. I ran `ExtractGitHistoryFileHandlerTest`, the only test class that mentions landscape, and it passed silently. No test covers `getAllTeams()` directly, so the new behaviour is verified by reading the code, not by a test. Nothing was committed.
